Exercise A

The vocabulary list

These are all 26 words. Nothing else is tested, here or in the test — read them once, then start Exercise B.

WordWhat it means
Aboriginal peoplethe first people who lived in Australia
to struggleto try very hard to do something difficult
to be known asto be called this name by everyone
the outbackthe dry, empty land in the middle of Australia
greatvery big, or very good
to attendto go to a school, class or event
satellite disha round dish that receives TV or internet signals
necessarysomething you must have or must do
up toas far as, but no further
boarding schoola school where the students also live
termone of the parts a school year is divided into
in additionas well as something else
Australianfrom Australia, or a person from Australia
easy-goingrelaxed and not easily worried
continentone of the seven big land areas of the world
Antarcticathe frozen land at the South Pole
isolationbeing far away from other people
unusualnot normal; not what you often see
speciesone kind of animal or plant
to existto be real and be there
koalaa grey Australian animal that lives in trees
kangarooan Australian animal that jumps on strong back legs
availablethat you can get or use
skilledtrained and good at a job
carpentera person who makes things from wood
nursea person who looks after sick people in a hospital

Choose the right meaning for each word. You can check as often as you like — the first correct answer scores a full point, the second half a point. Every word from the list comes up once.
